1.content: Analyze recruitment platform requirements and create project structure
1.details:
Define the platform architecture, user flows, and core functionality:
- Job seeker focused platform
- General recruitment across all industries
- Simple, clean interface design
- Job posting and management system
- Search and filter capabilities
- Responsive design for mobile/desktop

2.details:
Create a modern, clean recruitment platform frontend:
- Homepage with hero section and featured jobs
- Job listings page with advanced search and filters
- Job detail pages with application forms
- User authentication (job seekers)
- Responsive design with mobile-first approach
- Clean, professional styling

3.content: Develop backend database and API system
3.details:
Implement Supabase backend infrastructure:
- Job postings database with categories, locations, skills
- Company profiles and information
- User authentication and profiles for job seekers
- Application tracking system
- Search and filtering APIs
- Email notifications for applications

4.details:
Build comprehensive job management system:
- Admin panel for posting and managing jobs
- Job categories and skill tags
- Location-based job filtering
- Salary range filtering
- Job type filters (full-time, part-time, remote)
- Application deadline management

5.content: Add advanced search and filtering capabilities
5.details:
Implement robust search functionality:
- Keyword search across job titles and descriptions
- Location-based search with geolocation
- Industry/category filters
- Experience level filters
- Salary range filters
- Company size filters
- Remote work options

6.content: Test and deploy the recruitment platform
6.details:
Comprehensive testing and deployment:
- Functionality testing across all features
- Mobile responsiveness testing
- Performance optimization
- SEO optimization for job listings
- Deploy to production with live URL
- Create sample job data for demonstration
